name: @apnex/headless-chromium
description: Drive headless Chromium for a test: a Chrome on a port the system gives it, in a folder of its own, a DevTools session with trusted input and focus loss, and a static server -- each gone without a trace when closed or when whatever started it dies.
author: apnex

scripts.gate: npm test && node tools/check-vocabulary.mjs && node tools/check-source.mjs && node tools/check-runtime.mjs && node tools/check-export-map.mjs && node tools/check-public-text.mjs && node tools/check-style.mjs
